name: Art & Famous Paintings - very easy (AI-written, not yet reviewed)
description: 17 very easy questions on art and famous paintings, written by Claude on 2026-10-06 as the gentlest level of the 'Art & Famous Paintings' review pack: things almost everyone knows, in one short plain sentence, worded for adults. They are marked easy with a note "very easy" until the very easy level lands. The fact-check judged 3 of them merely easy and took off their note, so the pack is 14 very easy, 3 easy. The independent fact-check kept 17 of 17 written, fixed 5 and deleted 0. Every question and answer needs checking by a person before anybody plays it.

source.name: Written by hand by Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) on 2026-10-06, from its own knowledge plus the pages each item cites: no API call. 10 items cite a page the writing pass fetched on 2026-10-06 and quote the phrase on it that supports the fact; 7 rest on "common knowledge" (genuinely universal everyday facts), each with the reason. Then fact-checked item by item by a separate Claude pass on 2026-10-06 that did not write them (every cited page re-fetched and read for the fact, every answer, wrong answer, explanation and level checked; `checked` keeps who checked it and what was fixed; items that could not be made right, and duplicates of other packs, were deleted). Very easy items are marked difficulty "easy" with "note": "very easy" until the very easy level lands. A person still reviews it by playing.

review.how: Check every question, answer and explanation. Fix or delete what is wrong, set status to 'reviewed' with your name and the date, then move the file to packs/ and list it in pack_library.js.

items.question: What color do you get by mixing red and yellow paint?

items.question: In painting, red, yellow and blue are called the what colors?
items.explain: Painters mix these three to make many other colors.

checked.fixed: source note now quotes the sentence that names red, yellow and blue as primary colors (old quote came from a CMY caption)
